Measured over `test/fixtures/` on 2026-10-04, with:

```
resvg           0.48.1
pngquant        3.0.3
oxipng          oxipng 10.2.1
@napi-rs/image  1.15.0
@gfx/zopfli     1.0.15
node            v26.10.0
```

These numbers come from the fixtures in this repository, which are not the 39-mark
corpus the original decisions were taken on. Where they disagree, these are the ones
to trust: they are the ones you can reproduce.

## Accuracy: pct by mark, size and palette size

pct = share of pixels more than 8/255 from an unquantised reference, worse of a white and a black composite. The bar is 1.0 %. `gradient` is excluded from the worst-case line: it exists to make the lossless path win, and no palette of 256 or fewer colours holds a four-stop gradient inside the bar, so the size guard (decision 7) is what decides it.

## Which candidate wins, at --colors 256 (the default)

One row per (mark, size) over 10 marks x 5 sizes. "keep smallest" is the guard from decision 7: it costs nothing when it never fires and stops a raised --colors from producing larger files.

```
files                 50
no dither wins        42
Floyd-Steinberg wins  1
no pngquant wins      7

always no-dither      85123 B
keep smallest         84877 B  (-0.29 %)
```

## Stage order at 192 px

pngquant re-encodes from scratch, so anything oxipng did before it is discarded. The measurement is not close.

```
pngquant then oxipng  15650 B
oxipng then pngquant  18937 B  (21.0 %)
```

## Zopfli iterations

The baseline is 15, oxipng's default and the fast mode's count; release builds use 120. Bytes ship forever and build time does not, so the knee is taken on the byte side, but the curve is flat past 120.

```
  --zi     bytes    vs 15   seconds
    15     61222    0.00%      46.7
    30     61133   -0.15%      89.6
    60     61122   -0.16%     155.8
   120     61065   -0.26%     329.6
   240     61016   -0.34%     575.7
```

## Serial against concurrent rasters (decision 13, re-measured)

Four jobs (180 px on a ground, 192, 512 and the 32 px ICO payload) through the full pipeline. 3 interleaved repetitions per arm, identical work in every arm, on a 16-core machine. The --zi axis is here because favicon.sh passes a bare --zopfli (which is --zi 15) where favcon passes --zi 120, and a comparison that varied only the scheduling would have credited that to concurrency.

```
 at once  --zi     wall     min     max  child cpu   cores    bytes  vs shipped
1 (serial)   120   20.77s   19.41   23.11     169.3s    8.1x     5418        0.0%
       4   120   20.28s   19.51   21.59     236.9s   11.7x     5418       -2.4%
1 (serial)    15    5.22s    5.05    5.43      37.4s    7.2x     5467      -74.9%
       4    15    4.64s    4.63    4.64      53.8s   11.6x     5467      -77.7%
```

**concurrency buys 2.4 % at --zi 120; dropping to --zi 15 buys 74.9 % and costs 49 B**

```
BMP payload           39340 B  (8.8x)
byte-identical to icotool -c -r   10/10
```
